{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the sentinel value in biomarker_baseline is -999
n_sentinel_biomarker = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Total number of patients
n_patients = len(trial_df)

# Report
print(f'Number of patients: {n_patients}')
print(f'Number of patients with biomarker_baseline == -999: {n_sentinel_biomarker}')"}
